mainline/jiaochang#1.t: Eastern Capital · Training Ground of the Marshal's Office

mainline/jiaochang#2.zh: 话说哲宗皇帝在位时，东京开封府汴梁城里有个浮浪破落户子弟，姓高，排行第二，自小不成家业，只好刺枪使棒，最是踢得好脚气毬，京师人都叫他做高毬。后来发迹，便将气毬那字去了「毛」傍，添作「立人」，改作姓高名俅。
mainline/jiaochang#2.t: In the reign of Emperor Zhezong, there lived in Bianliang, the Eastern Capital, a good-for-nothing wastrel, surnamed Gao and the second son of his family. He never learned a trade; all he cared for was spear and staff play, and above all he could kick a football like no one else, so the whole capital called him Gao Qiu, "Gao the Ball." When he later rose in the world, he dropped the "fur" radical from the character for ball and gave it the "man" radical instead, and so his name became Gao Qiu.

mainline/jiaochang#3.zh: 这高俅凭一脚好球得了端王欢心。后来端王做了天子，便是道君皇帝，不到半年，抬举高俅做到殿帅府太尉。
mainline/jiaochang#3.t: With his fine footwork this Gao Qiu won the favour of Prince Duan. When Prince Duan became the Daojun Emperor, in less than half a year he raised Gao Qiu to Grand Marshal of the Imperial Guard.

mainline/jiaochang#4.zh: 殿帅府里有个八十万禁军教头，姓王名进。这些时日患病在家，今日病体初愈，便到教场里来看军士操练。
mainline/jiaochang#4.t: In the Marshal's Office there served a drill instructor of the eight hundred thousand Imperial Guards, named Wang Jin. He had lain sick at home for some time; today, newly recovered, he came to the training ground to watch the soldiers drill.

mainline/jiaochang#5.zh: 教头病好了！小的们都盼着教头指点几路棒法。
mainline/jiaochang#5.t: The Instructor is well again! We've all been hoping you'd teach us a few staff moves.

mainline/jiaochang#6.zh: 教头，弟兄们今日都在，正好操演一回。
mainline/jiaochang#6.t: Instructor, all the men are here today. A good day for a drill.

mainline/jiaochang#7.zh: 好。张牌、李牌，你两个看仔细了：临阵对敌，先要知道怎么走、怎么打、怎么守。
mainline/jiaochang#7.t: Very well. Zhang Pai, Li Pai, watch closely: in battle, first you must know how to move, how to strike and how to guard.

mainline/jiaochang#9.t: Skip the tutorial, go to the story

mainline/jiaochang#10.zh: 要不要跟着王教头操练一遍？（操作教学，约十分钟）
mainline/jiaochang#10.t: Drill with Instructor Wang? (controls tutorial, about ten minutes)

mainline/jiaochang#11.zh: 王进在教场里操演了一日，众军士无不叹服。
mainline/jiaochang#11.t: Wang Jin drilled on the training ground all day, and every soldier was full of admiration.

mainline/jiaochang#12.zh: 先说站位。我走到前面那一格，你们看着。
mainline/jiaochang#12.t: First, footwork. I'll step to that square up ahead. Watch.

mainline/jiaochang#13.zh: 【教学 1/8 · 移动】点王进（或点他脚下的格子），在弹出的菜单里选「移动」，地图上会标出走得到的格子，再点标出的目标格。目标格在地图和小地图上用颜色标出。
mainline/jiaochang#13.t: [Tutorial 1/8 · Moving] Click Wang Jin (or the square he stands on) and choose "Move" from the menu. The squares he can reach light up; click the marked target square. The target is highlighted on the map and on the minimap.

mainline/jiaochang#14.zh: 教学 1/8 --- 移动：让王进走到标出的格子
mainline/jiaochang#14.t: Tutorial 1/8 --- Move: walk Wang Jin to the marked square

mainline/jiaochang#15.zh: 提示       --- 点人物 → 移动 → 点目标格
mainline/jiaochang#15.t: Tip        --- Click the unit → Move → click the target

mainline/jiaochang#16.zh: 【教学】走过以后，这一回合还能出手；没走满的步数也还能再走。出手之前，菜单里的「撤销移动」可以退回原地。
mainline/jiaochang#16.t: [Tutorial] After moving you can still act this turn, and any steps you didn't use can still be walked. Until you act, "Undo Move" in the menu puts you back where you started.

mainline/jiaochang#19.zh: 【教学 2/8 · 攻击】走到陪练军士旁边一格，选「攻击」，再点他。选中目标后，屏幕下方会显示命中率和预计伤害。没打中也不要紧，下回合再来。
mainline/jiaochang#19.t: [Tutorial 2/8 · Attacking] Walk next to the sparring soldier, choose "Attack", then click him. Once a target is selected, the bottom of the screen shows the hit chance and expected damage. If you miss, no matter: try again next turn.

mainline/jiaochang#20.zh: 【教学】王进出过手，这一回合就算行动完了。我方的人都行动完会自动「回合终了」，轮到对方；也可以随时按右上角的「回合终了」。
mainline/jiaochang#20.t: [Tutorial] Wang Jin has acted, so he is done for this turn. When all your units have acted the turn ends by itself and the other side moves; you can also press "End Turn" at the top right at any time.

mainline/jiaochang#21.zh: 教学 2/8 --- 攻击：打中陪练军士一下
mainline/jiaochang#21.t: Tutorial 2/8 --- Attack: land a hit on the sparring soldier

mainline/jiaochang#22.zh: 提示       --- 走到旁边 → 攻击 → 点目标
mainline/jiaochang#22.t: Tip        --- Walk next to him → Attack → click the target

mainline/jiaochang#23.zh: 哎哟！教头好棒法，小的服了！
mainline/jiaochang#23.t: Ow! What a staff, Instructor. I give!

mainline/jiaochang#24.zh: 正面打人，人家看得见，躲得开、挡得住。临阵要会抢人背后。
mainline/jiaochang#24.t: Hit a man from the front and he sees it coming: he can dodge or block. In battle, learn to get behind your enemy.

mainline/jiaochang#25.zh: 这两个弟兄背对着教头，教头绕过去试试。
mainline/jiaochang#25.t: These two have their backs to you, Instructor. Go round and try it.

mainline/jiaochang#26.zh: 【教学 3/8 · 背后与侧面】人物有朝向。从背后打，命中高得多，伤害 ×1.25；从侧面打，伤害 ×1.1。绕到陪练军士背后或侧面，再攻击他。
mainline/jiaochang#26.t: [Tutorial 3/8 · Back and Flank] Units face a direction. A hit from behind is far more likely to land and does ×1.25 damage; from the side, ×1.1. Get behind or beside a sparring soldier, then attack him.

mainline/jiaochang#27.zh: 教学 3/8 --- 从背后或侧面攻击陪练军士
mainline/jiaochang#27.t: Tutorial 3/8 --- Attack a sparring soldier from behind or the side

mainline/jiaochang#28.zh: 提示       --- 他们面朝里，绕到身后那一格再攻击
mainline/jiaochang#28.t: Tip        --- They face inward: step to the square behind one and attack

mainline/jiaochang#29.zh: 教头，那是正面！绕到他身后再打。
mainline/jiaochang#29.t: Instructor, that was from the front! Go round behind him.

mainline/jiaochang#30.zh: 哎呀，背后吃了一棒，竟没瞧见！
mainline/jiaochang#30.t: Ouch! Took one in the back and never saw it coming!

mainline/jiaochang#31.zh: 这就是了。反过来，人家抢你背后，你也要会守。
mainline/jiaochang#31.t: That's it. And the other way round: when someone gets behind you, you must know how to guard.

mainline/jiaochang#32.zh: 教头摆好架势，我们两个便一齐上！
mainline/jiaochang#32.t: Once the Instructor takes his stance, the two of us come at him together!

mainline/jiaochang#33.zh: 【教学 4/8 · 防御与反击】选「防御」，王进这一回合不出手，挨打时伤害减三成；对方贴身打过来被你闪开，还有一半机会顺势反击，反击必定打中。王进摆出防御架势，两个陪练才会攻上来。
mainline/jiaochang#33.t: [Tutorial 4/8 · Defend and Counter] Choose "Defend": Wang Jin skips his attack this turn and takes 30% less damage. If a close-range attack misses him, he has a 50% chance to counter, and a counter always hits. The two sparring soldiers only come at him once he takes a defensive stance.

mainline/jiaochang#34.zh: 【教学】王进这一回合已经出过手，等对方回合过去（自动「回合终了」），下一回合再点王进选「防御」。
mainline/jiaochang#34.t: [Tutorial] Wang Jin has already acted this turn. Let the other side's turn pass (the turn ends by itself), then next turn click Wang Jin and choose "Defend".

mainline/jiaochang#35.zh: 教学 4/8 --- 防御：让王进防御，挨对方一下
mainline/jiaochang#35.t: Tutorial 4/8 --- Defend: have Wang Jin defend and take a blow

mainline/jiaochang#36.zh: 提示       --- 点王进 → 防御 → 等对方回合
mainline/jiaochang#36.t: Tip        --- Click Wang Jin → Defend → wait for their turn

mainline/jiaochang#38.zh: 教头先别还手，这一节是练守的，选「防御」。
mainline/jiaochang#38.t: Don't hit back yet, Instructor. This lesson is guarding: choose "Defend".

mainline/jiaochang#39.zh: 好！闪开就是一棒，这便是反击！
mainline/jiaochang#39.t: Good! Dodge, then strike: that's a counter!

mainline/jiaochang#40.zh: 教头守得严实，打不进去！
mainline/jiaochang#40.t: His guard is too tight. We can't get through!

mainline/jiaochang#41.zh: 守住了，再寻空当还手。好，退下罢。
mainline/jiaochang#41.t: Hold your guard, then look for an opening to strike back. Good, step down.

mainline/jiaochang#42.zh: 教头手下留情，小的认输！

mainline/jiaochang#44.zh: 也罢，守的功夫，日后临阵再练。
mainline/jiaochang#44.t: Very well. The art of guarding you'll learn in real battle.

mainline/jiaochang#45.zh: 也罢，守的功夫，日后临阵再练。
mainline/jiaochang#45.t: Very well. The art of guarding you'll learn in real battle.

mainline/jiaochang#46.zh: 教头，再教我们几路真本事！
mainline/jiaochang#46.t: Instructor, teach us some real moves!

mainline/jiaochang#47.zh: 看好了，这几路是家传的。
mainline/jiaochang#47.t: Watch closely. These forms run in my family.

mainline/jiaochang#48.zh: 【教学 5/8 · 技能与气】选「技能」，列表里是会的招式，后面的数字是要耗的气（人物头上的黄条）；气不够的招式是灰的。选好招式，地图上标出射程，指着格子能看到打到哪几格，再点一下出招。等级升上去还会领悟新招。
mainline/jiaochang#48.t: [Tutorial 5/8 · Skills and Qi] Choose "Skills" to list the moves you know. The number after each is the Qi it costs (the yellow bar over the unit's head); moves you can't afford are greyed out. Pick a move and its range appears on the map; point at a square to see which squares it hits, then click to use it. New moves are learned as you level up.

mainline/jiaochang#49.zh: 教学 5/8 --- 技能：对陪练军士用一次技能
mainline/jiaochang#49.t: Tutorial 5/8 --- Skill: use a skill on a sparring soldier

mainline/jiaochang#50.zh: 提示       --- 点王进 → 技能 → 选一招 → 点目标
mainline/jiaochang#50.t: Tip        --- Click Wang Jin → Skills → pick a move → click the target

mainline/jiaochang#51.zh: 教头，那是寻常一棒。打开「技能」，使一路招式给我们看看！
mainline/jiaochang#51.t: Instructor, that was a plain blow. Open "Skills" and show us a proper form!

mainline/jiaochang#52.t: What a staff! We're in awe!

mainline/jiaochang#53.t: ...Cough, cough. Only just over the sickness; my strength isn't back yet.

mainline/jiaochang#54.zh: 教头身上带着膏药，先贴上歇一歇。
mainline/jiaochang#54.t: You've got plasters on you, Instructor. Put one on and rest a moment.

mainline/jiaochang#55.zh: 【教学 6/8 · 道具】选「道具」，点狗皮膏药，再选「使用」，点王进自己（也可以给身边的人用）。用道具不算行动，用完还能做别的事；「给予」能把东西交给身边的自己人。
mainline/jiaochang#55.t: [Tutorial 6/8 · Items] Choose "Items", click the Dog-Skin Plaster, choose "Use", then click Wang Jin himself (you can also use it on someone beside you). Using an item doesn't count as your action, so you can still do something else afterwards; "Give" hands an item to a friendly unit beside you.

mainline/jiaochang#56.zh: 【教学】出过手的人这一回合就不能再用道具了。等回合终了，下一回合再点王进用膏药。
mainline/jiaochang#56.t: [Tutorial] A unit that has already acted can't use items this turn. Wait for the turn to end, then next turn click Wang Jin and use the plaster.

mainline/jiaochang#57.zh: 教学 6/8 --- 道具：用一次狗皮膏药
mainline/jiaochang#57.t: Tutorial 6/8 --- Items: use a Dog-Skin Plaster once

mainline/jiaochang#58.zh: 提示       --- 点王进 → 道具 → 狗皮膏药 → 使用
mainline/jiaochang#58.t: Tip        --- Click Wang Jin → Items → Dog-Skin Plaster → Use

mainline/jiaochang#59.t: That's better. Training also means knowing when to rest.

mainline/jiaochang#60.zh: 【教学 7/8 · 休息】还没出手的人可以选「休息」，回复最大体力和气的五分之一，这一回合就不再行动。回合终了时还没行动的人会自动休息或防御。
mainline/jiaochang#60.t: [Tutorial 7/8 · Resting] A unit that hasn't acted yet can choose "Rest" to recover one fifth of its max HP and Qi, ending its turn. At the end of the turn, anyone who hasn't acted rests or defends automatically.

mainline/jiaochang#61.zh: 教学 7/8 --- 休息：让王进休息一次
mainline/jiaochang#61.t: Tutorial 7/8 --- Rest: have Wang Jin rest once

mainline/jiaochang#62.zh: 提示       --- 点王进 → 休息

mainline/jiaochang#63.zh: 最后操演一阵抢旗。张牌扛着令旗随我上将台；台上两个弟兄守着，抢上去便算赢。
mainline/jiaochang#63.t: One last drill: capture the platform. Zhang Pai, carry the command flag and follow me up the reviewing platform. Two of our men guard it; get up there and we win.

mainline/jiaochang#65.zh: 【教学 8/8 · 胜负条件】张牌现在也归你指挥，下回合起和王进一样点他行动。每关开头都会说明胜利、失败条件，随时可以按顶栏的「目标」按钮再看；要去的地方在地图和右下角小地图上标出来。
mainline/jiaochang#65.t: [Tutorial 8/8 · Victory Conditions] Zhang Pai is now under your command too: from next turn, click him and give orders just like Wang Jin. Every stage begins by stating its victory and defeat conditions, and you can check them again any time with the "Goals" button at the top. Places you need to reach are marked on the map and on the minimap at the bottom right.

mainline/jiaochang#66.zh: 教学 8/8 --- 胜利条件：张牌走进将台（标出的区域）
mainline/jiaochang#66.t: Tutorial 8/8 --- Victory: get Zhang Pai onto the reviewing platform (marked area)

mainline/jiaochang#67.zh: 失败条件   --- 王进或张牌倒下
mainline/jiaochang#67.t: Defeat     --- Wang Jin or Zhang Pai falls

mainline/jiaochang#68.zh: 正面打不进去的。教头绕到他身后！
mainline/jiaochang#68.t: You can't get through from the front. Go round behind him, Instructor!

mainline/jiaochang#69.zh: 正面打不进去的。教头绕到他身后！
mainline/jiaochang#69.t: You can't get through from the front. Go round behind him, Instructor!

mainline/jiaochang#72.t: The flag is on the platform!

mainline/jiaochang#73.zh: 操演得好。你们记着：走、打、守、招式、歇息，样样都要熟。
mainline/jiaochang#73.t: Well drilled. Remember: moving, striking, guarding, skills and resting. Master every one of them.

mainline/jiaochang#74.zh: 【教学完毕】以后每一关照这样打。打不过时，顶栏的「时光倒流」能回到之前的回合重来。
mainline/jiaochang#74.t: [Tutorial complete] Fight every stage this way. If a battle goes badly, "Rewind" at the top takes you back to an earlier turn to try again.

mainline/jiaochang#75.zh: 王教头，不好了！新任高殿帅今日到任点名，满营官员都去参拜，只欠你一个。太尉大怒，说你推病在家，不伏他点视，亲自寻到教场来了！
mainline/jiaochang#75.t: Instructor Wang, trouble! The new Marshal Gao took up his post today and called the roll. Every officer in camp went to pay respects; only you were missing. The Marshal is furious. He says you are feigning sickness to dodge his inspection, and he's coming to the training ground himself!

mainline/jiaochang#76.zh: 我病了半月，今日才好，正待去参拜……
mainline/jiaochang#76.t: I've been ill for half a month and only today recovered. I was just about to go and pay my respects...

mainline/jiaochang#77.zh: 你那厮便是都军教头王昇的儿子？
mainline/jiaochang#77.t: So you're the son of Wang Sheng, the army instructor?

mainline/jiaochang#79.zh: 这厮！你爷是街市上使花棒卖药的，你省的甚么武艺？前官没眼，参你做个教头，如何敢小觑我，不伏俺点视！你托谁的势要推病在家安闲快乐？
mainline/jiaochang#79.t: You wretch! Your father was a street peddler who twirled a painted staff to sell medicine. What do you know of martial arts? My blind predecessor made you an instructor, and you dare slight me and skip my inspection! Whose backing are you counting on, idling at home on a pretend sickness?

mainline/jiaochang#80.zh: 小人怎敢。其实患病未痊。
mainline/jiaochang#80.t: I would never dare, sir. I truly have not fully recovered.

mainline/jiaochang#81.zh: 贼配军！你既害病，如何来得？左右，与我拿下这厮，加力与我打！
mainline/jiaochang#81.t: Convict! If you're so sick, how did you get here? Guards, seize this fellow and give him a sound beating!

mainline/jiaochang#82.zh: 太尉，今日是太尉上任好日头，权免此人这一次。
mainline/jiaochang#82.t: Marshal, today is the auspicious first day of your office. Pardon this man just this once.

mainline/jiaochang#83.zh: 你这贼配军，且看众将之面，饶恕你今日之犯，明日却和你理会！
mainline/jiaochang#83.t: You convict! For the sake of these officers I'll spare you today's offence. Tomorrow I'll settle with you!

mainline/jiaochang#84.zh: 俺道是甚么高殿帅，却原来正是东京帮闲的圆社高二！比先时曾学使棒，被我父亲一棒打翻，三四个月将息不起，有此之仇。他今日发迹，得做殿帅府太尉，正待要报仇。我不想正属他管，自古道：「不怕官，只怕管。」俺如何与他争得？
mainline/jiaochang#84.t: Marshal Gao, I thought: who is he? And he turns out to be Gao the Second, that hanger-on of the football clubs in the capital! Years ago, when he was learning the staff, my father knocked him flat with one blow; he couldn't get up for three or four months. That's the grudge. Now he has risen to Grand Marshal and means to take his revenge. Who'd have thought I'd end up under his command? As the old saying goes: "Fear not the official, fear the one you answer to." How can I ever stand against him?

mainline/jiaochang#85.zh: 王进当众受辱，闷闷回到家中。
mainline/jiaochang#85.t: Humiliated before the whole camp, Wang Jin went home in low spirits.

mainline/jiaochang#86.zh: 张牌哥哥扛着旗，弟兄们别真打伤了他！
mainline/jiaochang#86.t: Brother Zhang Pai is carrying the flag. Lads, don't actually hurt him!

mainline/jiaochang#87.zh: 教头大病初愈，弟兄们下手轻些！
mainline/jiaochang#87.t: The Instructor's only just recovered. Go easy, lads!

mainline/jiaochang#88.zh: 众军士都放慢了手脚。王进喘了口气，精神又足了。
mainline/jiaochang#88.t: The soldiers all slowed their blows. Wang Jin caught his breath and his strength came back.

mainline/jiaochang#89.zh: 王进力尽倒地。再操演一回吧。
mainline/jiaochang#89.t: Wang Jin collapses, spent. Let's drill again.

mainline/jiaochang#90.zh: 张牌被打倒了。再操演一回吧。
mainline/jiaochang#90.t: Zhang Pai has been knocked down. Let's drill again.
